translations.web: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,
translations.bsb: Yet he did not waver through disbelief in the promise of God, but was strengthened in his faith and gave glory to God,
translations.kjv: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
translations.asv: yet, looking unto the promise of God, he wavered not through unbelief, but waxed strong through faith, giving glory to God,
